text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yawn… It's a day off today. I guess I'll do some shopping.

text_block_list.name: News Anchor
text_block_list.text: In today's horoscope… the third luckiest is Aries! It looks like today will be an extra lucky day for you folks!

text_block_list.name: Checkout Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh! Aren't you lucky?! You won big on the receipt raffle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Did you just say I won big?! …Could that mean… first priz—

text_block_list.name: Checkout Lady
text_block_list.text: Third-prize! No one has won this yet!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: C-come on, Nature, look on the bright side. The third-place prize is probably still pretty fancy, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha… hahaha… I guess I shouldn't have got my hopes up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sinking her shoulders in disappointment, Nice Nature wonders what to do with such an abundance of scourers.
